what: Pre-lint snapshot commit helper omits pre-dirty unchanged-path exclusion
scenario_or_breakage: Loop-start HEAD diff includes hunks that were dirty before lint-fix; post-loop commit can land unrelated pre-existing edits on those paths
suggested_fix: Mirror pre-coder snapshot machinery: capture per-path wt/index patches at lint-loop entry and commit only paths whose diffs diverge from those snapshots (reuse _path_matches_pre_coder_snapshot logic)

what: Step 7 --stage-all still uses git add -A plus bare commit
scenario_or_breakage: Unrelated staged or dirty files at Step 7 can ride into the review-fix commit despite pathspec-only lint-fix goals
suggested_fix: Change commit_fixes --stage-all to stage via pathspec-from-file built from review deltas only, matching _stage_and_commit_round

what: [SCOPE-REDUCTION] Incident-scoped CI self-heal adds large _run_cycle branch
scenario_or_breakage: Pre-commit plus implementer checklist already prevent #1/#2; self-heal is optional cost for faster CI recovery
suggested_fix: Defer ci_agentic_fix mechanical helpers; ship prevent fast-lane and review-loop commit fixes first

what: Ready-to-commit stall wiring lacks explicit stdout capture contract
scenario_or_breakage: Background fence output may not be bound before Step 6; resume-handoff-commit-failed routing can be skipped silently
suggested_fix: Require orchestrator to capture step-5-resume.sh stdout and parse COMMITTED ERROR SHA STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS from that capture before continuing
